pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Whole adult man seated at a small table, confidently holding a round wooden block just above a matching circular hole in a shape board, with triangle and square blocks aside. Other index finger touches temple. Small thought bubble shows matching circle block, conveying he KNOWS the answer. Complete table, chair and man. No question marks or text. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
